## Highlights

- Fixed the Windows desktop startup path so the bundled NOVA backend runs without opening a console window and the desktop client can pair with the local engine.
- Refined the desktop experience for Windows and Arabic users with taskbar-aware maximize behavior, responsive settings layouts, and a consistent Qt Quick Controls style.

## Desktop Fixes

- Replaced the stale pairing-file dependency with the native desktop auto-pairing contract.
- Suppressed backend child-process console output while retaining the app's structured runtime logging.
- Made maximize and restore use the usable screen geometry, keeping the Windows taskbar visible.
- Improved Arabic settings scrolling, available-width handling, responsive columns, and switch-label wrapping.
- Fixed optional torrent reauthentication state handling and Qt Quick control customization warnings.

## Build and Validation

- Added regression checks for native desktop startup, window geometry, Arabic settings layout, and control-style configuration.
- Updated desktop pairing evidence in the parity manifest and regenerated shared design-token outputs.
- Made the Windows installer smoke test wait for GUI installers and check process exit codes reliably.
- Removed expected parity error annotations from successful CI runs and disabled unsupported CodeQL overlay mode for the manually built Kotlin database.
- Required release preflight: strict quality checks, Rust and Android compatibility, all six desktop platform builds, and Windows x64/ARM64 installer smoke checks.

## Alpha Scope

This is an alpha preview. Cross-platform feature parity and live-device acceptance remain in progress. The signed automatic updater remains disabled until its production endpoint and verification key are configured. Stable production releases continue to require complete parity coverage.
